SAMPLE-1 trial of a synthetic study drug versus placebo in adults with type 2 diabetes

Methods. Participants were randomised 1:1 to the study drug or placebo for 24 weeks. Additional analyses are given in Supplementary Table S2 and Supplementary Figure S1.

Table 2. Baseline characteristics of the study population

| Characteristic | Placebo (n=120) | Study drug (n=118) | P value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Age, years, mean (SD) | 61.2 (9.8) | 60.7 (10.1) | 0.71 |
| Male sex, n (%) | 72 (60.0) | 69 (58.5) | 0.81 |
| Hypertension, n (%)^a^ | 80 (66.7) | 71 (60.2) | 0.30 |
| Diabetes duration, y, median (IQR) | 8 (5–12) | 9 (5–13) | 0.55 |
| Prior MI, n/N (%) | 11/120 (9.2) | 14/118 (11.9) | 0.52 |
| HbA1c, % | 7.9 | 8.0 | 0.64 |
| Smoker, n (%) | 30 (26.0) | 25 (21.2) | 0.38 |
| Week 12 | 1 | 2 | <0.001 |

^a^ Systolic blood pressure of at least 140 mmHg or treatment with an antihypertensive agent.
* Student t test for continuous variables; chi-square test for categorical variables.
Data are n (%) unless stated.

Table 3. Primary and secondary outcomes at week 24

| Outcome | Study drug | Placebo | Hazard ratio (95% CI) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary composite, n/N (%) | 22/118 (18.6) | 38/120 (31.7) | 0.52 (0.31–0.88) |
| Death from any cause, n/N (%) | 6/118 (5.1) | 9/120 (7.5) | 0.66 (0.23–1.86) |
| Hospitalisation, n/N (%) | 15/118 (12.7) | 27/120 (22.5) | 0.50 (0.27–0.94) |
| Change in HbA1c, % | −0.9 | −0.2 | not estimable |
| Adverse events, n (%) | 41 (34.7) | 38 (31.7) | 1.1.2 |

Figure 2. Kaplan-Meier estimates of the primary composite outcome over 24 weeks.

Figure 3 shows the time to first hospitalisation.
